description:
Kobi Raham is a publicly listed business contact and apparent executive leader of Y.O.R. Construction & Investments, a family-owned, licensed and insured Southern California general contracting company. The company’s Houzz profile lists Kobi Raham as the business name/contact, while a public professional profile identifies him as chief executive at Y.O.R. Construction and Investment.
houzz
+1

At Y.O.R., Kobi’s apparent leadership remit spans the client-facing and operational sides of a broad construction practice. The company positions itself as an integrated design-build contractor serving projects from early site analysis, design input, and budget consulting through construction and final occupancy. Its service mix covers single-family residential, remodeling, additions, accessory dwelling units, commercial work, pools, patios and decks, roofing, foundations, hardscape/concrete, windows, seismic retrofitting, painting, HVAC, and solar-related installations.

Kobi is therefore best positioned as a senior decision-maker for homeowners, property owners, and commercial clients seeking a single accountable contractor rather than a trade-specific vendor. The company emphasizes coordinating designers, supervisors, employees, and qualified subcontractors; using detailed documentation and cost-verification procedures; maintaining progress communication; and completing work on time and within an agreed budget.
